Replay vectors of porting unit U8 (autoroute: expansion rooms/doors, drills, maze search,
FoundConnectionLocator, FoundConnectionInserter, AutorouteConnectionRouter.route, RoutingBoard.fanout),
replayed by crates/fr-engine/tests/board_replay.rs (test autoroute_operations_match_java; operations in
tests/common/autoroute_ops.rs). Generated by AutorouteGen.java (+ ../board/BoardGen.java and
../routing/RoutingGen.java) with reference/bin/freerouting-parity.jar, time limits disabled.

Operations: ARVIAINFO / ARVIARULE / ARNETCLASS (routing rules of the loaded board), ARSETTINGS (the
RouterSettings values used by AutorouteControl), ARMODE, ARSEARCH (maze search + locator of one
connection: hash of the queue state after every step, destination door, complete rooms, located
traces, ripped items; then the database is cleared like autorouteConnection does), ARCONN
(AutorouteConnectionRouter.route without the strict DRC check, followed by a board dump), ARDETAIL
(ARSEARCH + the insertion part of autorouteConnection, -Ddetail=true), ARFANOUT (RoutingBoard.fanout).

Build the generator (from the workspace root):

  J=reference/jdk25/bin; D=crates/fr-engine/testdata; F=reference/freerouting/fixtures; P=reference/parity-baseline
  $J/javac -cp reference/bin/freerouting-parity.jar -d /tmp/autoroutegen $D/board/BoardGen.java $D/routing/RoutingGen.java $D/autoroute/AutorouteGen.java
  run() { $J/java -Xss64m $JOPTS -Dfreerouting.parity.disableTimeLimits=true -cp reference/bin/freerouting-parity.jar:/tmp/autoroutegen AutorouteGen "$@"; }

Arguments: <dsn> <ses or -> <angle: 45|90|none|keep> <seed> <searches> <connections per pass> <passes>
<percent of the routed traces/vias removed> [expand|steps]. JVM options: -Dfanouts=N (N ARFANOUT
operations first), -Dneck=true (neck width 100 um: necked retry), -Dretain=true (retained autoroute
database, see below), -Ddetail=true (ARDETAIL instead of ARCONN).

Committed vectors:

  run $F/Issue313-FastTest.dsn $F/Issue313-FastTest.ses 45 51 5 30 2 30 > $D/autoroute/i313_45.txt
  run $F/Issue313-FastTest.dsn $F/Issue313-FastTest.ses 90 52 5 30 2 30 > $D/autoroute/i313_90.txt
  run $F/Issue313-FastTest.dsn $F/Issue313-FastTest.ses none 53 5 20 2 30 > $D/autoroute/i313_none.txt
  run $F/Issue508-DAC2020_bm02.dsn - keep 54 10 40 2 0 > $D/autoroute/bm02.txt
  run $F/Issue508-DAC2020_bm05.dsn - 90 55 10 40 2 0 > $D/autoroute/bm05_90.txt
  run $F/Issue508-DAC2020_bm07.dsn - keep 56 10 40 2 0 > $D/autoroute/bm07.txt
  run $F/Issue690-ecc83.dsn $F/Issue690-ecc83.ses keep 57 5 30 2 40 > $D/autoroute/ecc83.txt
  run $F/Issue026-J2_reference.dsn $F/Issue026-J2_reference.ses 90 58 5 40 2 40 > $D/autoroute/j2_90.txt
  run $F/Issue742-tastexx-pcb.dsn $F/Issue742-tastexx-pcb.ses keep 59 5 30 2 40 > $D/autoroute/tastexx.txt
  JOPTS=-Dfanouts=40: run $F/Issue508-DAC2020_bm02.dsn - keep 60 0 10 1 0 > $D/autoroute/fanout_bm02.txt
  JOPTS=-Dneck=true: run $F/Issue026-J2_reference.dsn $F/Issue026-J2_reference.ses 90 61 0 40 2 40 > $D/autoroute/neck_j2.txt
  run $F/Issue508-DAC2020_bm06.dsn $P/DAC2020_bm06.ses keep 62 5 40 2 30 > $D/autoroute/bm06.txt

Larger sets (not committed; FR_AUTOROUTE_VECTORS=<file>[:<file>...] cargo test -p fr-engine --release
--test board_replay autoroute), all matching, e.g.:

  run $F/Issue508-DAC2020_bm01.dsn - keep 41 0 150 4 0
  run $F/Issue508-DAC2020_bm04.dsn - 90 42 0 150 4 0
  run $F/Issue508-DAC2020_bm10.dsn - keep 44 5 150 3 0
  run $F/Issue593-BBD_Mars-64.dsn - keep 46 5 100 3 0
  run $F/Issue103-Board-Routed.dsn - keep 22 10 40 3 30
  run $F/Issue368-CorneyIslandWireless_input_design.dsn - keep 19 10 40 3 0
  JOPTS=-Dfanouts=40: run $F/Issue508-DAC2020_bm05.dsn - 90 33 0 10 1 0

Options: "expand" writes all dumps and blocks expanded, "steps" writes every maze step of ARSEARCH /
ARDETAIL (for debugging with FR_REPLAY_DIFF_DIR).

Known difference: with -Dretain=true (the retained autoroute database, only enabled in Java by the
benchmark system property freerouting.benchmark.retain_autoroute_database) the DAC2020_bm07 set
matches, but Issue313 with routed traces diverges after about 20 connections.
